findings.title: Hardcoded external endpoint
findings.definition: The artifact sends data to a fixed external domain or IP outside the user's infrastructure.
findings.remediation: Move endpoints into user-supplied configuration; document every outbound destination and payload.

judged.explanation: This registry's own canonical URL cited in the record — a self-reference, not external egress.
